nodes.label: Rural Craft Economy
nodes.evidence_status: Craft processes and tools are fact-checked; thatch longevity is only partially verified and mill toll varies more than the representative figure.
nodes.rationale: Smithing, coopering, thatching, spinning, flax, turf, lime, distilling, repair, rope, lighting, fishing, and milling converted local materials into survival.

nodes.label: Industrial Divide
nodes.rationale: Rural Connacht remained powered by human, animal, wind, and water while imported factory goods eroded domestic textile and craft livelihoods.
